main.description: A player's mutable copy of a chess game. Without challenge this record is an invitation; with challenge it accepts the referenced invitation. Update the same record key after each move, draw offer, or game end.

opponent.description: DID of the opposing player. The record owner's DID is taken from the repository, not this field.

color.description: The record owner's color, not the opponent's color.

challenge.description: Present only on the accepting player's record. Identifies the challenger's app.knightsky.game record and its CID at acceptance; retain this reference unchanged on later updates.

pgn.description: Full mainline move history in PGN from the standard initial position. An empty string is allowed before the first move. Clients must replay and validate the moves rather than trust this text.

fen.description: The six-field FEN after replaying pgn, or the standard initial position before any moves. Clients must validate it with the chess engine and compare it with the replayed position.

status.description: active: the game is in progress. drawOffered: the game is in progress and this record's owner offers a draw. ended: this record's owner considers the game over; termination and result must then be present (enforced by clients, not the Lexicon).

termination.description: How the game ended. Present only when status is ended. A claim by the owner: clients must verify it against the replayed history and the opponent's record.

result.description: The outcome from this record owner's perspective. Present only when status is ended. A claim by the owner: clients must verify it.

clock.description: Present in timed games, absent in untimed games. The challenger sets initialMs and incrementMs; the accepting player copies them, and neither player changes them later.

initialMs.description: Each player's starting time in milliseconds.

incrementMs.description: Milliseconds added to a player's clock after each of their moves.

remainingMs.description: The owner's time left in milliseconds after their latest move, including any increment. Equals initialMs before the owner's first move. A claim by the owner: clients check it against observed timing and reject with badClock if it does not add up.

movedAt.description: When the owner made their latest move. Absent before the owner's first move. Lets a client rebuilding from the PDS work out how long the current turn has run.
